_comment: Central permission store for the Xplor RBAC System. Edit this file to change role permissions — no code changes needed.

admin._description: Full system access. Platform administrators only.

analyst._description: Analytics-focused access. Data analysts working with platform data.

viewer._description: Read-only access. Stakeholders and report consumers.

_permission_descriptions.manage_users: Create, edit, deactivate platform user accounts
_permission_descriptions.upload_dataset: Upload CSV or JSON datasets to the analytics platform
_permission_descriptions.delete_dataset: Permanently delete datasets from the platform
_permission_descriptions.analyze_data: Run AI models and analytics pipelines on datasets
_permission_descriptions.export_reports: Export analytics results to PDF, CSV, or external systems
_permission_descriptions.view_reports: View existing analytics reports and visualizations
_permission_descriptions.manage_roles: Assign and revoke roles for other users
